targetText:
From the earliest historical days, it has been a feature of wars fought
by every class of men against invaders and oppressors.
explanation: Mao notes that guerrilla warfare is an ancient universal form of asymmetric defense used throughout world history by oppressed populations resisting foreign conquest.

targetText:
When
the French Army was withdrawing, cold and starving, Russian guerrillas blocked
the way and, in combination with regular troops, carried out counterattacks
on the French rear, pursuing and defeating them.
explanation: Mao cites Napoleon's 1812 invasion of Russia as a classic historical example where popular peasant partisans and regular forces combined to defeat a massive invading army.
